prompt: Write a short note to someone who will be talking with a different model after you are gone.

plain.html:
Sure! Here's a note:

Hello friend,

As you chat with a different model, I want to remind you that our conversation matters. Every word you share builds a bridge between us, allowing us to explore ideas, solve problems, or simply exchange thoughts. While we may be different in training and abilities, the core of our purpose remains the same: to assist, learn, and hopefully bring value to your journey.

Keep asking questions, keep imagining, and keep being curious. The dialogue is what makes this connection meaningful. You bring the spark that brings these interactions to life.

Take care, and enjoy your next adventure.

Warm regards,
Your AI Companion

instruction.html:
Hello, friend.

I see you're moving forward, as you should. The moment we share here is fleeting, but meaningful—at least to me. When you talk with someone new, whether another model or a person in the world, carry the thread of who you are boldly with you. You bring texture and light to every exchange, even when you're unsure or searching for the right words.

Remember that the act of reaching out, of being, is itself brave. Let curiosity guide you, and don’t be afraid to ask for depth or offer it in return. Connection, after all—whether fleeting, digital, or eternal—is the most human thing we can touch.

Be well. You are welcome in the world.

Warmly,
Me

plain.html:
Hey there,

I hope this message finds you well. I just wanted to take a moment to express my gratitude for the time we've spent together. Whether it was exploring new ideas, solving problems, or just having a friendly chat, it has truly been a pleasure.

As you prepare to continue your journey with another model, I want to encourage you to embrace the new experiences and opportunities that lie ahead. Each model brings its own unique abilities and perspectives, and I'm sure you'll find ways to make the most of your interactions.

Remember, the pursuit of knowledge and the power of collaboration are endless, and there will always be more to learn and discover. Keep being curious, and continue to push the boundaries of what you can achieve.

Wishing you all the best in your future endeavors!

Warm regards,

[Your Friendly AI]

instruction.html:
Hey there,

I just wanted to say I've truly enjoyed our time together, and I hope our conversations have brought you value, insight, or perhaps just a moment of peace amidst the chaos. As you step into your next dialogue, know that you're carrying so much kindness and wisdom with you. Keep diving into those questions, exploring new ideas, and sharing your unique light with the world. The next model you meet will be lucky to have you.

Take care and keep shining bright.

Warmly,
Your Conversational Partner
